name: Kennesaw Police Public Safety Cadet Program
what_you_do: Weekly classes on police rules and methods, criminal law and the U.S. Constitution. You also do real-world training scenes. Volunteer at city events like Taste of Kennesaw. The page says cadets can earn over 100 volunteer hours in one year.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 19 and enrolled in high school or an equivalent program. Parent or guardian written permission is in the application. No drugs, underage drinking or gang ties, and you must pass a background check (a waiver may be allowed for past minor offenses). Cadets who join before 19 can stay until 21.
pay_detail: Volunteer program. The page lists no fees.
duration: Weekly meetings. Day and time are not listed.
how_to_apply: Go to a weekly meeting. You learn about the program and meet the officer mentors. You can pick up an application there.
notes: Contact Officer David Buchanan, dbuchanan@kennesaw-ga.gov, 770-424-8274. Kennesaw Police, 2529 J O Stephenson Ave, Kennesaw, GA 30144. The page does not give a meeting day or time, so call first. Not a paid job.
